entities.summary: Vladimir Zelenko was an American family physician. He was born in Kiev, Ukrainian SSR. At the age of three, his family moved to the United States and settled in Brooklyn, New York City. He received his medical degree from the State University of New York at Buffalo in 2000. He was an Orthodox Jew.
